status: frozen source candidate; independent review and generated closure pending
criteria: Equivalent authenticated preference records and private staged state to original scalar recovery, including two genuine encrypted revisions.
At most 32 physical blocks, eight actual private logs and two MiB per batch; conservative transport selection cannot confer authenticity.

Preserve every body/archive/transaction receipt/account/canonical validator, both settlement boundaries, immutable prior staged entries, exact final staged union, and encrypted cursor CAS/mailbox replay.
Reject malformed/mixed/oversize/reorg/account/stage mutation without partial cursor or private-state advancement.
Actual whole recovery remains <=120 seconds with <=10-second page deadline; focused fixtures do not prove this performance criterion.

source.scope: Conservative rc3 private-log-count hint; bounded serial transport prefix selected by remaining 0..8 log budget. Hint never authenticates a block.
Marker/extent/getter/size/budget/barrier regressions and existing transport guards.
Select at most 32 consecutive bodies and eight hinted private logs; unknown or large first body retains original scalar path; preserve all mailbox, anchor, CAS and publication fences.
Zero-log transaction and mixed-page selection with existing encrypted store/reader regressions; SDK/transport doubles remain labelled.

Authenticate every selected body/archive first; enforce actual eight-log/two-MiB bounds; sequential original transaction ingestion with immutable cumulative stage-prefix validators and final exact union.
Actual SDK/ACIR scalar equivalence, two revisions in one page, cumulative-stage mutation vetoes, bounds before staging, original dense-log and monotonic-prefix regressions.

generatedClosure.required: Stop consumers, preserve exact old closure, use existing owning installer; normal SDK/apps/wallet build and all 47 helper checks. Existing old-helper failure is not a pass or skipped requirement.

testEnvironment.nativeFlags: existing isolated SDK/ACIR fixture only; no live node, wallet, model, proof or transaction
testEnvironment.supervisor: existing check-pure-blob.mjs; 30-second / two-GiB process-tree bound; exact child arguments in receipts
